theme: The last calm day, then the long way home.
greeting: Your final day in Cavtat, then the journey home starts overnight — Dubrovnik to Frankfurt to Tampa, landing tomorrow afternoon. Before you board, two Florida bookings still need locking so you're not sorting them jet-lagged on the ground.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for tomorrow's landing
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA at 3:55 PM Sunday and the Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV (p1) is still unbooked — the decision is settled, only the booking is left. Don't arrive to walk-up rates, jet-lagged, on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Two nights in St Pete, Sept 20–21
needsAttention.detail: You land Sunday but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday, and the landing-gap lodging (p1) is still open. While you're in there, confirm the Sept 27–Oct 5 Airbnb actually converted from pending to booked.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV out of Portland
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out early. Book it refundable now (p1, due Sept 14) and adjust the dates later.

schedule.title: Fly Dubrovnik → Frankfurt
schedule.detail: LH4297, then UA9662 on to Tampa

schedule.title: Land Tampa (TPA)
schedule.detail: Home — ideally with a car already booked

flagged.title: LinkedIn request from a Deloitte consultant
flagged.detail: A senior consultant at Deloitte Canada sent a connection request — worth a look given the board-search networking.

flagged.title: FICO alert: card balance decreased
flagged.detail: A myFICO alert notes your JPMCB card balance dropped — routine, no action, just a heads-up.

flagged.title: Uber confirmed for the 5:35 AM pickup
flagged.detail: The Cavtat-to-airport ride for Sunday is booked — the transfer is handled.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shopping — NYT Cooking, Substack, market digests, Dermstore, and retail promos.
inbox.clear: Nothing else in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

resolved.title: Airport transfer is set
resolved.detail: Uber confirmed the 5:35 AM Cavtat pickup for Sunday, closing the disembark-day transfer worry.

recipe.title: Vin santo–roasted pears
recipe.why: Pears are at their autumn peak now, and slow-roasting deepens their honeyed sweetness.

tasks.title: Grocery stop before the Orlando villa

acts.line: A quiet last morning in Cavtat with nothing on the books before the flight home.
The all-inclusive is yours until the bags are packed — one more look at the Adriatic.
The long haul begins tonight: 5:35 AM pickup, Dubrovnik to Frankfurt to Tampa, on the ground by 3:55 PM Sunday.
